name: Kudzu
source:
Spend your days surrounded by flowers, helping visitors, and discovering the hidden stories that only the shop can tell. Who knows what mysteries you might uncover?

[From [url=https://keyesque.itch.io/kudzu]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在繁花簇拥中度过日常时光，帮助到访的客人，发掘唯有这家花店才能道出的隐秘故事。谁知道你会揭开怎样的谜团呢？
